body: A wound around authority and achievement: a sense of not being legitimate no matter how much you accomplish.
business: You become a steadying mentor who helps others claim earned authority.
shadow: Overworking to prove worth, or rejecting authority entirely.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
